q: 1. Public works must be of very good quality, because
options: it is paid in higher rate
users are general public and maintenance is not timely difficulty and costly
explain: But as per book b. Public works serve the general public continuously; poor quality causes costly, delayed maintenance affecting many users, so high quality is essential.

q: 2. A project is
options: a large dam constructed across a river for a single or multi-purpose
any job involving many people and large money
a work of major importance involving huge men and material
an organized team work to achieve a set task within the time limit
explain: A project is generally defined as an organized, coordinated effort of a team to accomplish a specific objective within a defined time frame.

q: 3. Policy is
options: a rule or a set of rules never to be violated
a definite route along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of broad guidelines stipulated by management
explain: Policy refers to broad guidelines set by management to direct decision-making, distinct from rigid rules or fixed procedures.

q: 4. In a line organization
options: responsibility of each individual is fixed
explain: Line organization has strong discipline, quick decisions and fixed responsibility.

q: 5. The major principle of an organization is
explain: Span of management, unity of command and delegation of authority are all basic principles.

q: 6. The first stage of a construction, is
explain: Construction begins with the initiation of the proposal/idea, before surveys, estimates, or fund allotment occur.

q: 7. The main function of the construction management is
explain: Construction management encompasses all managerial functions - planning, organizing, and directing - to achieve project objectives.

q: 8. Frederick W. Taylor introduced a system of working know as
explain: F.W. Taylor introduced functional organization, dividing management functions among specialists.

q: 9. The most popular type of organization used for civil engineering constructions is
explain: Line and staff organization combines direct command with specialist advisory support, making it most suitable and popular for civil engineering construction.

q: 10. The probability of completion of any activity within its expected time is
explain: At the expected time Z = 0, so the probability is 50%.

q: 11. Residential buildings are treated as
explain: Residential buildings, being relatively small-scale structures, are classified as light construction.

explain: Per the answer key, a. Note: option d is a misprint in the book.

q: 13. In PERT technique the critical path has slack equal to
explain: Critical path slack is zero, or negative if the schedule is behind.

q: 14. Which of the following is not another name of Hoe?
explain: A trenching machine is a different machine. Backhoe, back-shovel and pull shovel are names for the hoe.

q: 15. Hoe is primarily used to excavate
options: below the natural surface of the ground on which the machine rests
trenches requiring precise control of depth
pits of basements requiring precise control of depth
explain: A hoe digs below its own level, including trenches and basement pits.

q: 16. Idlers are
options: used to provide supports for belt conveyor system
explain: Idlers are the rollers that support a conveyor belt.

q: 17. The main purpose of planned maintenance of roads is:
options: to keep road surface in a good condition
to reduce the vehicle operation costs
to reduce the total transportation costs
explain: Planned road maintenance primarily aims to reduce vehicle operation costs by keeping roads in a condition that minimizes wear and fuel consumption for users.

q: 18. Project maintenance is
explain: Project/asset maintenance is a continuous, ongoing process throughout the life of the facility, not a one-time or optional activity.

q: 19. The field of activities of an engineer includes
options: approval of construction plans by the local authority
inspection and payment of work done by contractor
explain: All of these fall within the engineer's field.

q: 20. Responsibility of civil Engineer is
explain: A civil engineer's responsibilities span supervision, quality control, and BOQ preparation - all of the above.

q: 21. The which one is not concerned with the responsibility of Engineer
explain: While engineers handle technical planning, supervision, and scheduling, core accounting (financial bookkeeping) is typically the responsibility of the accounts department or an accountant.

q: 22. The types of construction in which more equipment are used, is known as capital intensive while the construction in which more human labours are used, is called
explain: Labour-intensive construction relies primarily on manual human effort rather than heavy machinery or automated equipment.

q: 23. The most critical stage of a construction is construction of
explain: The foundation is the most critical stage because it supports the entire structure; any failure here is difficult and expensive to rectify.

q: 24. Site order book is used for recording
explain: A site order book is a legal record where the engineer or site in-charge writes specific instructions for the contractor to follow.

q: 25. The main disadvantage of line organization is
explain: A major drawback is that authority is concentrated at the top, which can lead to autocratic leadership and lack of specialized input.

q: 26. Line organization is mostly suitable for
explain: Due to its simplicity and lack of specialized staff, line organization works best for straightforward projects with fewer complexities.

q: 27. The salient feature of functional organization, is
options: each individual maintains functional design part
work is properly planned and distributed
explain: Functional organization emphasizes specialization, where work is divided and managed by experts in specific functional areas.

q: 28. Line & staff organization is mostly suitable for
explain: This hybrid model combines direct authority (line) with expert advice (staff), making it suitable for both simple and complex large-scale projects.

q: 29. Duty of obligation to satisfactorily perform a task that one must fulfill and which has a consequent penalty for failure is
explain: That is responsibility.

q: 30. Contingencies should be justified
options: Explicitly, in advance of committing to the budget
Implicitly, to allow for a management reserve
At the time the budget is prepared
explain: Good practice requires contingencies to be explicitly justified and documented in advance, before the budget is committed, ensuring transparency.

q: 31. The decomposition process is a technique used to construct a:
explain: Decomposition is the technique of breaking down project scope into smaller components to build a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).

q: 32. The first topic to address in a project kickoff meeting is:
explain: A kickoff meeting typically begins by establishing roles and responsibilities among the project team before diving into plans and schedules.

q: 33. The most crucial time for project risk assessment is
explain: Risk assessment is most crucial during the planning phase, allowing proactive identification and mitigation before execution begins.
